learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected About 100 and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Zero delay equated report 100 to current infections. Nine-day preset gave 800, eight times report. Three-day preset gave 200. End twelve days gave 1600, sixteen times. Home restored zero; restored nine before reveal.
observations.reveal: Corrected to 800 by three doublings, referenced visited three and twelve day cases, contrasted growing with flat curve and stated made-up outbreak, steady doubling and identical delays with real delays variable.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected. Green report and pink current-infection curves, legends, dashed lag linkage and present-time vertical gap visible. Explanation and caveat legible.
observations.previewIsolation: Preview banner said history and analytics are not saved.
observations.blinding: No source, builder notes or other reviews inspected.

prediction.reason: Concrete count commitment tests treating delayed report as current state.

interaction.reason: Delay presets and endpoints show multiplicative lag effect reversibly.
interaction.evidence: Zero, three, nine and twelve days compared.

payoff.reason: Reveal traces three doublings and explains dependence on growth.
payoff.evidence: 100 times two three times; flat curve contrast.

clarity.reason: Color legends and text ratios connect past report to present state.
clarity.evidence: Reported and actually infected curves labeled; toy assumptions explicit.

transfer.reason: Growing-versus-flat condition is given but no new application is attempted.
transfer.evidence: Photo of past analogy and flat-curve caveat.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard endpoints and text summaries observed; screen reader, contrast and reduced motion unaudited.

surprise.reason: A report of 100 can accompany 800 current infections in stated model.

visualExplanation.reason: Shift and gap make reporting lag visible.

playfulness.evidence: Two presets and continuous day range.

practicalValue.reason: Supports interpreting delayed indicators during growth.

depth.reason: Combines compounding and delayed observation with assumptions.

complexity.reason: Simple controls require repeated doubling and time-shift reasoning.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Separate observation date from event date during exponential growth.
complexity.interfaceBurden: One day slider and two presets.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: Reporting delay and steady doubling introduced in question.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: Time-series curves, days, ratios and multiplication chain.

whyCool: A lagging report is a photograph of a smaller past during rapid growth.
caveat: Fixed delays and constant doubling are toy assumptions; this review makes no real-outbreak inference.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
